name: Readwise
description: Access your full library of Readwise highlights and Reader documents: search them semantically, save new documents, create new highlights, move documents, tag them, etc. Using the exposed tools, you can trivially triage your library, organize your library, and give Claude access to every word of everything you've read.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Readwise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Readwise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp2.readwise.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Readwise MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Readwise lists 22 MCP tools, including readwise_search_highlights, readwise_create_highlights, readwise_list_highlights, readwise_update_highlight, readwise_delete_highlight, readwise_get_daily_review, reader_search_documents, reader_create_document, reader_list_documents, reader_get_document_details, reader_list_tags, and reader_add_tags_to_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Readwise?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Readwise in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Readwise requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Readwise is developed by Readwise Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
